title: moss.intervention_requested (v1)
description: ResearchOrchestrator asks MOSS to intervene (e.g. a loop/counter threshold was hit) and optionally hands over a snapshot of the counters that triggered the request. MOSS Step 1 -- this is the frozen contract only; no consumer wired yet.

reason.description: Free-form description of why MOSS's intervention is being requested (e.g. 'loop detected', 'budget exhausted').

counter_snapshot.description: Opaque snapshot of the counters/state that triggered the request, or null if not applicable.

method_ref.description: Current Method including component designs and dependency/acceptance contracts; design context, not execution proof.

baseline_result_ref.description: Optional frozen baseline with authoritative task and repository requirements.

spec_interpretation_ref.description: Optional frozen evaluation semantics and comparison constraints.

research_memory_ref.description: Optional frozen ResearchMemory evidence for MOSS diagnosis.

run_record_ref.description: Optional frozen RunRecord for the failing experiment MOSS is diagnosing.

baseline_attempt_ref.description: Latest baseline attempt for diagnosis, including failed attempts; not a frozen comparison baseline.

agent_failure.description: Current component preparation agent.failed payload, when no new RunRecord exists. Takes precedence over an earlier run.

critique_report_ref.description: Optional frozen CritiqueReport for a rejected plan or proposal MOSS is diagnosing.
